answer: Proof of Compute serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to perform verifiable work, creating a ridge of economic difficulty that an attacker cannot scale. Like a terrace carved into a mountain, each layer of verification increases the cost of entry, ensuring that an adversary must expend significant energy and capital at the dawn of every transaction cycle. This forces malicious actors to internalize the full financial cost of their computational output, rendering large-scale identity fabrication economically unfeasible.
